entries.clue: Scented liquid for the drawer that stops jumpers going scratchy
Dark ring left by spilled wine that no hot cycle shifts
Read this title in reverse and you have the slow shelled pet at its heart
Small bookworm able to tip over a glass with nothing but a hard stare
Idle talk across the folding table about the neighbours
Cocoa sweet, churned by waterfall, that runs as a river through the factory
Jam-spread cake curled into a spiral log and cut into rounds
Devon and Cornwall argue over whether jam or cream goes first on this
Holey griddle round whose dimples flood with melted butter
Sprouted grain, kilned and sweet, behind a sticky dark fruit loaf
Sack for carrying it all, or to nab the free dryer first
Patricia ___, the actress wife Dahl drilled back to speech after strokes
